resolved_conflicts.explanation: The state report quoted on the Forest Lookouts page places the 1911 tower on a hill near Gull Lake, west of Brainerd. The Cass County list puts a 1911-12 tower on Dutchman's Bluff on the north shore and lists the 1937 Tower #19 separately on the west side. The FFLA coordinates match Tower #19, so the record follows that tower.

notes_for_editor: Identity of the 1911 tower is contested: the weebly page puts it west of Brainerd, the Cass list on Dutchman's Bluff. The FFLA coordinates match Tower #19 (1937). No removal date or account was found in the sources read. The brief's agency field was null; the Cass list owner column reads Mn MFS and the 1949 item names the Minnesota State Forest Service, so agency is set from that.
